card.title: Recruit Them Twice
card.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Join my campaign to save the club garden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our extension plan. The one we both signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We know the opposition's weaknesses. Will you join the honest version?
